description: The HTBM bamboo-hut INTERIORS, packaged as the linked inside for the stilt-village shells (`bamboohut01`, `bamboohut02` and the composites that hang `bamboohutdoor01` on them). The mod ships each hut as a matched pair — the exterior shell and a `_Int` room authored to sit inside exactly that shell — so this kit is pure packaging of the halves that were already authored to fit: nothing here is combined with anything it was not made for. `Villages/Argonian/BambooHut01_Int` and `BambooHut02_Int` are the two Argonian-quarter rooms; `Villages/Kothringi/BambooHut01_Int` is the Kothringi variant of the same room, kept separate because it is a different authored mesh with its own dressing, not a retexture. The hut door leaf travels with them: it is the visible half of the teleport link. Interior dressing is the wicker furniture the mod's own village folder ships alongside the huts and nothing else — no piece is borrowed from another pool, because a bamboo room dressed in Imperial or Nord furniture would read as the wrong culture inside an Argonian silhouette. Built 2026-09-07: the five blueprints already named these `_Int` meshes as their interiors while no kit packaged them, so the link they promised could not be built.

snapLogic.rooms: Each `*_int` mesh is a WHOLE room, not a tile: it is placed at the same origin and yaw as the exterior shell it belongs to, and it snaps to nothing else. `bamboohut01_int` goes inside `bamboohut01`, `bamboohut02_int` inside `bamboohut02` (and inside the `composite:stilt/bamboohut0*-with-door` composites, which are those shells with the door hung on). The Kothringi `bamboohut01_int` is the room for the Kothringi quarter's huts and is never mixed with the Argonian pair in one village.
snapLogic.door: `bamboohutdoor01` is the leaf the link uses. It hangs in the exterior shell's opening at the offset the mod's own placements use (recorded as the stilt kit's composites); the interior side of the same doorway is modelled into the `_int` room.
snapLogic.dressing: `wickerchair01`, `wickersofa01`, `wickertable01`, `wickerbasket01` and `chestwicker01` are the mod's own village furniture. They are loose props placed on the room's floor plane, not snapped: seat and table against a wall bay, baskets and the wicker chest in the corners.
snapLogic.unitScale: Bethesda units; 0.0142240 m/unit. Measured extents per piece in tooling/asset-pipeline/output/kits/htbm-hut-int.kit.json.
